card.name: Linking words before sulfonylurea examples
card.fires_on: Linking words such as 'as', 'e.g.,' and 'or' right before a drug example, mostly sulfonylureas after insulin secretagogues. Also the 'pos' inside 'ketoconazole posaconazole' in azole antifungal lists.

modes.label: Inside posaconazole
